result.title: Result percentages
result.intro: Home, draw and away probabilities shown on the match page.

statsPredictor.title: Stats predictor
statsPredictor.intro: What each team is expected to get in xG, shots, shots on target, corners, fouls and yellow cards, on the match page. Here: whether it gets right which team gets more.

cornerDuel.title: Corner duel
cornerDuel.intro: The probability of each team taking more corners than the other, on the match page.

probablePicks.title: Likely picks
probablePicks.intro: Patterns a team has repeated many times, checked against what the opponent does, up to 6 per match.

highProbability.title: High probability
highProbability.intro: At most one selection per match from the pattern model.

result_1x2.title: Most likely result (1X2)
result_1x2.what: Who wins or whether it is a draw.
result_1x2.how: The average of our own calibrated Elo and a monthly Dixon-Coles. It does not use the market.
result_1x2.versus: Compared with: the market favourite, only in matches with odds.

result_double.title: Best double chance
result_double.how: The most likely one according to the 1X2 above, so it does not use the market either.
result_double.versus: Compared with: the most likely double chance according to the market, only in matches with odds.

probable_picks.title: Likely picks
probable_picks.what: Whether each match's picks come true.
probable_picks.how: Patterns met in at least 80% of the team's matches, checked against the opponent.
probable_picks.versus: Compared with: the event's frequency in the league.

high_probability.title: High probability
high_probability.what: Whether the match's selection comes true.
high_probability.how: It combines the market without margin, Dixon-Coles and the patterns: unlike the 1X2, it does use the market as an input. Only at 62% or more and 3 points above the market, and at most one per match.
high_probability.versus: Compared with: the probability the market gave.

stats_predictor.title: Predictor: which team gets more
stats_predictor.what: Which team gets more of each stat.
stats_predictor.how: Our own model: it gives more weight to recent matches and pulls each team towards the league average. For yellow cards, the referee also counts.
stats_predictor.versus: Compared with: the team with the higher average over its last 10 matches.

corner_duel.title: Corner duel: most likely result
corner_duel.how: Our own model: it gives more weight to recent matches and pulls each team towards the league average, using what it takes at its venue and what the opponent concedes at its own.
corner_duel.versus: Compared with: the team with more corners on average over its last 10 matches.

uncalibratedNote: The Champions League is not part of this model's evaluation: its figures are shown, but they do not count in the totals.
